requirement: All offshore wind turbines must maintain a minimum clearance of 22 meters above Mean High Water (MHW) to ensure navigational safety.
source: BOEM Technical Standards for Offshore Renewable Energy

requirement: Construction activities must avoid marine mammal migratory pathways between November and April.
Turbine design must comply with IEC 61400-3 standards.
All wind farm developments must conduct a full environmental impact assessment prior to construction
Turbine foundations must withstand wave forces with a return period of 50 years
Minimum distance between turbines shall be 5 times the rotor diameter
All projects must conduct a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) prior to construction
scope: All offshore wind projects in EU waters

requirement: Foundations must withstand 1-in-50-year extreme wave conditions
